name: SG800
tagline: Elegant modern fireplace with an extra-wide architectural log store base
description: The SG800 is a premium, contemporary wood stove designed with a clean, geometric silhouette to complement modern living spaces. Weighing 142kg, it features an expansive rectangular glass door framed in a smooth matte-black finish, providing an exceptional view of the fire. The firebox sits perfectly centered on an extra-wide, low-profile open plinth that serves as an artistic and practical log storage bench, creating a dramatic, horizontal focal point.
features: Substantial 142kg high-grade frame engineered for efficient heat distribution
Extra-wide integrated open plinth base serving as a spacious log storage bench
Large panoramic ceramic glass window for an uninterrupted, vivid view of the flames
Minimalist front door assembly with an integrated sleek vertical metal handle
Centered top flue outlet configuration optimized for elegant, straight chimney setups
